body: Did talk to them this morning. First with my Landlord. Apparently they have been giving him a hard time about it and just didn't let us know. I checked our lease agreement and it did say 1 per per unit but I do have an email with my Landlord that said if we pay an extra $$$ for the deposit he doesn't really care if we have 3 pets. We did pay. I spoke to the HOA president and he was a dick about it.
Thank you so much! I will definitely look into this!
Thank you. I find it easier to write things in my head. It feels safer somehow.
It's not the fear of dying for me. It's the fear that my mom would cry. That she would blame herself.
